name: create_compatibility_results
update_user_compatibility_results
detail:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_user_compatibility_results(user_id uuid, new_aura_id integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  other_aura_id int;
  new_score numeric;
begin
  -- Update where user is user_a
  for other_aura_id in
    select user_b_aura_id from compatibility_results where user_a_id = user_id
  loop
    -- Try (new_aura_id, other_aura_id)
    select compatibility_score into new_score
    from animal_compatibility
    where animal_a_id = new_aura_id and animal_b_id = other_aura_id
    limit 1;

    -- If not found, try (other_aura_id, new_aura_id)
    if new_score is null then
      select compatibility_score into new_score
      from animal_compatibility
      where animal_a_id = other_aura_id and animal_b_id = new_aura_id
      limit 1;
    end if;

    update compatibility_results
    set user_a_aura_id = new_aura_id,
        compatibility_score = coalesce(new_score, 0)
    where user_a_id = user_id and user_b_aura_id = other_aura_id;
  end loop;

  -- Update where user is user_b
  for other_aura_id in
    select user_a_aura_id from compatibility_results where user_b_id = user_id
  loop
    -- Try (other_aura_id, new_aura_id)
    select compatibility_score into new_score
    from animal_compatibility
    where animal_a_id = other_aura_id and animal_b_id = new_aura_id
    limit 1;

    -- If not found, try (new_aura_id, other_aura_id)
    if new_score is null then
      select compatibility_score into new_score
      from animal_compatibility
      where animal_a_id = new_aura_id and animal_b_id = other_aura_id
      limit 1;
    end if;

    update compatibility_results
    set user_b_aura_id = new_aura_id,
        compatibility_score = coalesce(new_score, 0)
    where user_b_id = user_id and user_a_aura_id = other_aura_id;
  end loop;
end;
$function$
